mainEntity.name: Does a 1990s septic system still need an inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Age is only one factor. Baffles, tees, filters and lines fail on their own schedule, roots don't care what year a tank was poured, and the bedroom count on the permit may not match the house today.

mainEntity.name: Do you inspect manufactured-home septic systems in Conover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The first thing I compare is the permit's bedroom count with the home as it stands, additions included, because that's where manufactured-home systems most often fall short.
With Catawba County Environmental Health in Newton. Request a copy of an existing permit online through the county's Environmental Health forms page, or email EHAdmin@catawbacountync.gov.
